gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-spline-sans: Stencilia stands tall and structural, its curves leaving generous gaps at the terminals. Spline Sans brings a lower, friendlier lowercase where every stroke carries the same weight, and that steady footing is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-almendra: Stark, striking letters up top, then a bookish surprise. Almendra, a classic serif with a deep midsection in its lowercase, gives Stencilia's structure a dignified partner, and the mix of display bluntness with old-fashioned warmth is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its oversized lowercase giving each line a generous, confident presence on the page. Stencilia stands above it with structural punch.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-port-lligat-slab: Stencilia's most striking habit is the spacious gap left at its curve terminals, giving the letters a cut-open, structural look. Port Lligat Slab follows with wide, porthole-like counters and a traditional feel, so a long passage would read warmly and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-quando: Quando reads bookish and traditional, its sparse spacing and tall middle zone giving every word a stretched-out presence. Stencilia's compact, structural capitals sit above it, and the two feel deliberately mismatched in the best way.
gen-dafont-stencilia-outfit: Approachable is the first impression Outfit gives, though Stencilia is the more striking voice. Stencilia does best at structural, high-standing display lines, while Outfit's cable-like curves, with no swelling or thinning, are built for quietly carrying the text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline plain sans whose curve endings stay well apart from one another and from Stencilia's heavier look. Over many lines it moves smoothly.
gen-dafont-stencilia-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk opens up its counters like a hollow reed cut open. Stencilia is the tall, structural one in the pair, while the plain sans body keeps a ribbon of constant width, and that difference in height is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-plein: Spread-out and luxurious, Stentiga looks like a held breath. Plein follows with a reliable sans whose round letters have a clear channel leading in, so the wide-tracked display above gets a lower, grounded companion.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-spline-sans: Refined Stentiga opens its letters wide, tracking spaced out like a door left ajar. Spline Sans gives the pair its strongest quality: a lower, approachable sans-serif body whose strokes share one weight, which makes the heading's luxury feel easy to approach.
